headline_marked: Govt decides [[Purbachal New Town to come under Dhaka district]] for administration
headline: Govt decides Purbachal New Town to come under Dhaka district for administration
summary: The move aims to streamline administration as the project area currently spans across Dhaka, Narayanganj, and Gazipur districts.
details: The government has decided to bring the entire Purbachal New Town project under the administration of Dhaka district to streamline its management.
The decision was made during the 121st meeting of the National Implementation Committee for Administrative Reorganisation (NICAR), chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.
Purbachal New Town is currently spread across Dhaka, Rupganj upazila of Narayanganj, and Kaliganj upazila of Gazipur, which has created administrative complications.
Following a proposal from the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, the committee approved the realignment of the project area.
Additionally, NICAR approved the creation of three new upazilas: 'Fatikchhari Uttar' in Chattogram, 'Bangra' in Cumilla, and 'Dakkhin Gafargaon' in Mymensingh.
The committee also approved a proposal to split Hathazari Police Station in Chattogram to establish the new Halda Police Station.
A proposal to establish a separate Roads and Highways Department zone in Bogura was withdrawn as it fell outside the committee's jurisdiction.
caption:
Purbachal New Town is moving under one district. No more administrative overlap between Dhaka, Narayanganj, and Gazipur.

The government has decided to bring the entire Purbachal New Town project under the administration of Dhaka district to streamline its management.

The decision was made during the 121st meeting of the National Implementation Committee for Administrative Reorganisation (NICAR), chaired by Prime Minister Tarique Rahman.

Purbachal New Town is currently spread across Dhaka, Rupganj upazila of Narayanganj, and Kaliganj upazila of Gazipur, which has created administrative complications.

Following a proposal from the Ministry of Housing and Public Works, the committee approved the realignment of the project area.

Additionally, NICAR approved the creation of three new upazilas: 'Fatikchhari Uttar' in Chattogram, 'Bangra' in Cumilla, and 'Dakkhin Gafargaon' in Mymensingh.

The committee also approved a proposal to split Hathazari Police Station in Chattogram to establish the new Halda Police Station.

A proposal to establish a separate Roads and Highways Department zone in Bogura was withdrawn as it fell outside the committee's jurisdiction.

headline_marked: 13-year-old [[student killed in bus accident]] while going to school
headline: 13-year-old student killed in bus accident while going to school
summary: The Class 7 student was crushed by a bus in Satkhira's Tala upazila while riding on his father's motorcycle.
details: A 13-year-old student, Kushal Sarkar, was killed on Wednesday morning when a bus crushed his motorcycle in the Shahpur Bazar area of Satkhira's Tala upazila.
Kushal was a Class 7 student at Tala Brajen De Government High School. He was riding on the back of his father's motorcycle when the accident occurred around 9:00 AM on the Khulna-Paikgachha highway.
The victim's father, Kanai Lal Sarkar, a teacher at Kanaidah High School, was seriously injured in the crash and was rushed to a hospital by local residents.
According to local residents, a bus traveling from Paikgachha toward Khulna crushed the motorcycle, causing Kushal to be crushed under the wheels and die on the spot.
Tala Police Station Inspector (Investigation) Sakhawat Hossain confirmed the incident, stating that the police have seized the bus involved in the accident.
Legal action is being taken against the driver and the bus owner as the investigation continues.
caption:
A 13-year-old boy's journey to school ended in tragedy as he was crushed by a bus while riding with his father.

A 13-year-old student, Kushal Sarkar, was killed on Wednesday morning when a bus crushed his motorcycle in the Shahpur Bazar area of Satkhira's Tala upazila.

Kushal was a Class 7 student at Tala Brajen De Government High School. He was riding on the back of his father's motorcycle when the accident occurred around 9:00 AM on the Khulna-Paikgachha highway.

The victim's father, Kanai Lal Sarkar, a teacher at Kanaidah High School, was seriously injured in the crash and was rushed to a hospital by local residents.

According to local residents, a bus traveling from Paikgachha toward Khulna crushed the motorcycle, causing Kushal to be crushed under the wheels and die on the spot.

Tala Police Station Inspector (Investigation) Sakhawat Hossain confirmed the incident, stating that the police have seized the bus involved in the accident.

Legal action is being taken against the driver and the bus owner as the investigation continues.
